description: This file contains controller functions for managing user bank cards, including retrieving all cards, fetching a single card, changing the card PIN, and updating card limits, within a Strapi-based API.

methods.name: getMyCards
methods.description: Retrieves all cards owned by the current user.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific card by ID for the current user.

methods.name: changePin
methods.description: Updates the PIN of a specified card for the current user.

methods.name: changeLimits
methods.description: Updates various limits (daily/monthly online and withdrawal limits) for a specified card.
